svg.title: Dual ignition: two magnetos, two spark plugs per cylinder
svg.desc: Two independent magnetos, each driven by the engine, each feeding one spark plug in every cylinder through its own leads. If one magneto fails the engine keeps running on the other with a small loss of power. The ignition switch grounds (earths) a magneto to stop it; a broken earth lead leaves it live.
svg.text: engine: four cylinders, two plugs each
Ignition switch: OFF · R · L · BOTH · START
L earths the right magneto; OFF earths both
Two separate systems: lose one and the
engine runs on the other (small RPM drop)
A broken earth lead leaves a magneto live even at OFF:
